handbook.what: Everyone in the class, one row each, with their belt, how much they have learned, how much they have practised and when they were last at it. This is the answer to who is quietly drifting.
how: Read down the mark under each name, which flags anyone behind the class or long gone quiet.
Type a name into the search box to jump to one student.
Compare a student's practice against the class average shown in the rail beside the table.
handbook.note: A student who has never started shows as inactive rather than as behind, because nothing has happened yet to judge.
